deviations: Svelte 5 runes and typed Snippet composition replace React context and ReactNode APIs.
Native semantic controls and inline SVG/text glyphs replace icon and headless dependencies.
Token-only indented SASS and data-slot selectors replace utility classes.
Motion is implemented with reduced-motion-aware CSS or omitted where it is nonessential.
Canonical controlled/uncontrolled state and cleanup behavior are preserved within the public Svelte API.
